checks.title: Complete real onboarding within one business day
checks.evidence: Timestamps, tenant/workflow identifiers, provider responses, and audit events. Do not include credentials or recipient addresses.

checks.title: Inject onboarding failures and verify ownership-safe compensation
checks.evidence: Failure-injection plan, workflow history, compensation audit, reused Keycloak client survival, and proof that customer-owned Postiz integrations were not deleted.

checks.title: Run approved Content Cadence delivery across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and social
checks.evidence: Campaign/cycle identifiers, approval records, provider receipts, delivery webhooks, and per-cycle success counts for all four channels.

checks.title: Prove unapproved or rejected content produces zero provider calls
checks.evidence: Workflow history and provider audit showing no dispatch before approval and after rejection or approval timeout.

checks.title: Prove persistent suppression produces zero provider calls
checks.evidence: Suppression test record digest, authorization denial, PostgreSQL persistence check, and provider audit with no recipient addresses or HMAC secret.

checks.title: Suspend outbound messaging within five minutes and produce zero later provider calls
checks.evidence: Suspension and attempted-dispatch timestamps, denial reason, and provider audit demonstrating the five-minute limit.

checks.title: Verify dispatch replay, conflicting-replay rejection, and cross-tenant isolation in staging
checks.evidence: Idempotency keys, safe replay response, conflict response, cross-tenant denial, and exactly-once provider/usage reconciliation.

checks.title: Generate a real GPU-backed Studio pack in all contracted formats
checks.evidence: Model/runtime versions, GPU node identifier, ComfyUI job ID, graph version, output hashes, dimensions, and tenant-prefixed object keys.

checks.title: Reject a Studio asset and prove it never reaches delivery
checks.evidence: QA rejection reason, workflow history, object-prefix listing, and delivery audit showing no rejected asset delivery.

checks.title: Deliver the first client report within 48 hours of signup
checks.evidence: Signup, report-generation, approval, and delivery timestamps with tenant and report identifiers.

checks.title: Verify MFA, OIDC edge enforcement, invalid-token denial, and cross-tenant denial
checks.evidence: Sanitized OIDC configuration, MFA policy, positive/negative request results, and audit logs without tokens.

checks.title: Replace Wazuh bootstrap secrets and pass the purple-team drill
checks.evidence: Secret-pipeline review, certificate rotation record, four attack scenarios, and at least three detected alerts mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

checks.title: Restore M1 state with RPO at most 15 minutes and RTO at most 4 hours
checks.evidence: Dated quarterly drill for PostgreSQL, MinIO, Keycloak, and cluster state; backup/restore timestamps, data-loss measurement, validation queries, and next drill date. TigerBeetle joins this drill in M2.

checks.title: Validate live M1 SLO metrics, alerts, dashboards, and a monthly report
checks.evidence: Metric-contract implementation revision, Prometheus query output, alert test, dashboard screenshots/export, and monthly Core API 99.5% plus per-cycle dispatch 99% calculations.

checks.title: Run login and send synthetic journeys every five minutes with on-call alerts
checks.evidence: Probe configuration, at least one five-minute interval sample series, alert delivery, and monthly report. The pay journey is an M2 gate and must not be reported as M1 evidence.

checks.title: Reconcile provider charges with tenant/channel/campaign usage
checks.evidence: Provider invoice or sandbox statement, sanitized usage export, NGN-minor-unit/currency reconciliation, variances, and operator sign-off.
